title: Register two hosted claims dropped from the PRF event lists by the reach re-scope: the wildmat cursor work bound (PRF-016) and the config walks (PRF-383)
notes: PRF-016: register fn-wmc-core-codepoint-start-work-bound (books/wildmat-cursor.lisp; hosted through fn-wmc-start-codepoints) as an event with defteeth (positive witness, one removal witness per hypothesis, a mutation of the bound). The keystone_emit ratchet refuses a toothless new event.

PRF-383: register fn-cfg-rows-with-key (books/config.lisp) and fn-cfg-peer-names (books/peer-config.lisp) as guarded-function events, hosted, with teeth; PRF-383 has no registered events since p-reach-prose1 removed the def-loop witness lemma.
PRF-014 refinement of the generated fn-av-mca-read-span chain to the reference read is owned by PRF-1287-OWED (item 1 there), not here.
